line.a_kto_tam.text: Hey, who is hiding behind that bush?

line.a_zbudujemy.text: Don't worry, Hedgehog! We'll build you a house.

line.a_z_czego.text: But what will we build it from?

line.a_z_figur.text: From shapes! Every shape is different, and we can tell them by their corners and sides. First let's draw them.

line.a_kolo.text: This is a circle. Run your finger along the path, from the green dot.

line.a_kolo_ok.text: A circle is round and has no corners at all.

line.a_trojkat.text: And this is a triangle. Draw it with your finger.

line.a_policz.text: Show its corners. Touch every corner.

line.a_trzy_rogi.text: A triangle has three corners. It's pointy like the roof of a house.

line.a_kwadrat.text: And this is a square. Draw it with your finger.

line.a_cztery_rogi.text: A square has all its sides the same. It looks like a little window.

line.a_budujemy.text: Now we know the shapes. Let's build Hedgehog's house!

line.b_plan.text: The shapes are lying in the grass. We'll mark with a pencil where each one goes.

line.b_sciany.text: First the walls. The walls are a square. Drag the square into its place.

line.b_dach.text: Now the roof. A roof is a triangle, pointy at the top. Drag the triangle onto the walls.

line.b_okno.text: The window will be round. Which shape has no corners? Drag it onto the window.

line.b_drzwi.text: And the door is a rectangle, two long sides and two short ones. Drag the rectangle onto the door.

line.b_nie_ta.text: That shape doesn't fit here. Look at its corners and sides, and try another.

line.b_nie_ta.lisek.text: That shape doesn't fit here. Look at its corners and sides, and try another.

line.b_gotowy.text: The house is ready! Square walls, a triangle roof, a round window and a rectangle door.

line.b_dziekuje.text: My very own house! Thank you!

line.c_latawiec.text: My kite turned round and now I don't know which one it is. Mine was a square.

line.c_ktory.text: Which kite is a square? Point to it.

line.c_ktory_nie.text: That's not a square. A square has all its sides the same length.

line.c_obrocony.text: The square is only turned, but its sides are still all the same. A turned square is still a square!

line.c_turlam.text: And now I curl up into a ball and roll! Catch me, point to me.

line.c_do_domu.text: That was fun! Let's go home.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise shapes! I have five games.

line.p_tangram.text: Build the house from the pieces. Drag them, and tap to turn them.

line.p_trojkat.text: The shapes have turned round. Which one is the triangle? Point to it.

line.p_trojkat_nie.text: That's not a triangle. A triangle is pointy, like a roof.

line.p_prostokat.text: Draw a rectangle with your finger, from the green dot.

line.p_bez_rogow.text: Which shape has no corners at all? Point to it.

line.p_bez_rogow_nie.text: That shape has corners. Look for the round one.

line.p_kolorowanka.text: Colour the house. Pick a crayon with a number, then a space with the same number.

line.d_kuchnia.text: There are shapes in the kitchen too. Let's look for them!

line.d_talerz.text: What shape is the plate? Point to it.

line.d_czekolada.text: And what shape is the chocolate bar? Point to it.

line.d_nie.text: Look again at the corners and sides.

line.d_nie.lisek.text: Look again at the corners and sides.

line.d_kolo.text: Yes! The plate is round like a circle.

line.d_prostokat.text: Yes! The chocolate bar is a rectangle: two long sides, two short ones.

line.d_rodzice.text: Look for circles, squares, triangles and rectangles at home with your parents.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for my new house! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Hedgehog. We built him a house from shapes: a square, a triangle, a circle and a rectangle.

line.a_nie_mam_domu.text: It's me, Hedgehog... Winter is coming, and I have no house. I have nowhere to hide.

line.a_policz_trojkat.text: Let's count its corners. Touch every corner.

line.p_kolorowanka_znak.text: Colour the house. Pick a crayon with a sign, then a space with the same sign.
